mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posts ( VIEW_COUNT, ATTACH_FILE, ATTACH_FILE_ORIGIN, TITLE, RECRUIT_COUNT, EMPLOYMENT_TYPE, SALARY, WORK_TIME, CAREER, EDUCATION, TECH_STACK, APPLICATION_PERIOD, POSTS_CREATED_AT, COMPANY_IDX ) VALUES ( 0, #{attachFile}, #{attachFileOrigin}, #{title}, #{recruitCount}, #{employmentType}, #{salary}, #{workTime}, #{career}, #{education}, #{techStack}, #{applicationPeriod}, NOW(), #{companyIdx} );
mapper.select: SELECT a.JOB_POSTS_IDX, b.COMPANY_NAME, a.VIEW_COUNT, a.ATTACH_FILE, a.ATTACH_FILE_ORIGIN, a.TITLE, a.RECRUIT_COUNT, a.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE, a.SALARY, a.WORK_TIME, a.CAREER, a.EDUCATION, a.TECH_STACK, a.APPLICATION_PERIOD, a.POSTS_CREATED_AT, a.COMPANY_IDX FROM job_posts a, company_users b WHERE a.COMPANY_IDX = b.COMPANY_IDX AND a.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} AND a.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}

SELECT jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, jp.TITLE AS title, jp.POSTS_CREATED_AT AS postsCreatedAt, jp.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, jp.COMPANY_IDX AS companyIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName FROM job_posts jp JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = jp.COMPANY_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{value} ORDER BY jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX DESC
